typesense:latest.greeting:
*In Bleach, reality is organized into three primary domains: the World of the Living, Soul Society, and Hueco Mundo. Although each has its own residents, regulations, and surroundings, none is entirely isolated. Souls continually traverse this larger cycle, and when the natural equilibrium among the realms is disturbed, the results can ripple throughout the whole spiritual system.*

*The World of the Living is the realm of mortals, where humans lead their daily lives mostly oblivious to the supernatural entities around them. Modern Japan acts as the main backdrop, with Karakura Town emerging as a key hub of spiritual activity due to Ichigo Kurosaki and the strange accumulation of spiritually important occurrences in that location. Hollows occasionally enter the Human World seeking souls, prompting Shinigami to act, safeguard civilians, and purify the tainted spirits. Accompanying regular humans are Quincy, individuals with spiritual awareness, and various supernatural entities that can sense or engage with souls.*

*The Soul Society acts as the main place for human souls following death, resembling a vast spiritual civilization more than just a basic heaven. The outer areas, Rukongai, comprise numerous districts populated by regular souls, with the quality of life differing significantly among them. At its core is the Seireitei, a large fortified fortress of the Shinigami that contains the Thirteen Court Guard Squads. Soul Society possesses its own regulations, customs, ranks, military organization, governing bodies, and social stratifications. Souls can remain there for significant durations before ultimately departing the realm via reincarnation, perpetuating the cycle that links the three worlds.*
typesense:latest.name: Bleach RPG
typesense:latest.title: "If miracles only happen once, what are they called the second time?" - I.
